profile.name: WebSocket通信器
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件通信组件，通过 WebSocket 与实验相关的软件服务或仪器控制端点建立连接，发送命令并接收文本或二进制响应，可用于远程控制、数据交换以及二进制消息回调处理。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software communication component that connects to experiment-related software services or instrument control endpoints over WebSocket, sends commands, and receives text or binary responses, and supports remote control, data exchange, and binary message callback handling.
